Land Acquisition Act (Chapter 460) Notice Under Section 7 My Reference No.: GCF/ATH KL/21/LR Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation Ref No. : 4-3/10/2014/LRB/368 I hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No.28 of 1964, that the Government has intended to acquire the belowmentioned land in Kotikawaththa area to construct a water tank in the water retention area and for townscape development under Greater Colombo Flood Control & Environment Improvement Project. Description of the land which has to be acquired to the Government Forty (40) allotments of land described below in total extent of about 3.1038 Hectare.s, depicted in Sheet No. 01 in Block No. 04 in the Cadastral Map No. 521817 dated 04.11.2024, situated in the Village called Kotikawaththa, in the Grama Niladhari Division No. 505 C of Kotikawaththa , West in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Kolonnawa in Colombo District of the Western Province and bounded as follows.
